en.name: Anker Soundcore Motion 300 Speaker
en.shortDescription: Portable Bluetooth speaker with BassUp technology, IPX7 waterproof.
en.description:
## Anker Soundcore Motion 300

A portable speaker with BassUp technology for deeper bass and IPX7 waterproofing for poolside or beach use.

- 30W output, stereo sound
- 13-hour battery life
- IPX7 waterproof rating

so.name: Anker Soundcore Motion 300 Speaker
so.shortDescription: Weheliye Bluetooth ah oo la qaadan karo, leh tiknoolajiyad bass dheer iyo IPX7 biyo ka celin.
so.description:
## Anker Soundcore Motion 300

Weheliye la qaadan karo oo leh tiknoolajiyadda BassUp si bass-ku u sii dheeraado, leh IPX7 biyo ka celin oo ku habboon barkadda ama xeebta.

- Awoodda 30W, cod stereo ah
- Baytari socota 13 saacadood
- Heerka biyo ka celinta IPX7
